Elena (Product): Quick question  I'm going on parental leave starting Mon Nov 6 (6 weeks). My performance review cycle closes mid-November. Do I need to complete anything before I go so my review and bonus still get processed? Also any notes on benefits open enrollment while I'm on leave?

People Ops: Congrats! For reviews, please ask your manager to record your calibration notes before you go and nominate a proxy to submit any evidence if needed. The review timeline still applies; being on leave doesn't disqualify you from a normal review or bonus. If you'd like, set a reminder for a lightweight self-assessment before Nov 10.

Elena (Product): Thanks. Would a short 1-paragraph self-assessment be fine? I'm happy to do that instead of the full form.

Liam (Manager): A concise 1-paragraph summary + 2 bullets of impact is perfect. I'll put my manager note in calibration and confirm compensation recommendations. Tagging People Ops to confirm deadlines.

Comp & Ben: For bonus & comp processing: make sure any approval packets are in the review system by Nov 15. If you're on leave that week, we can still process approvals; just confirm that Liam has the necessary sign-offs. If you expect promotion/comp changes to start while you're out, notify comp@redwood.com now so we can calendar the change.

Elena (Product): Great, I'll drop the 1-paragraph and bullets by EOD Nov 9. About benefits open enrollment (Nov 1Nov 14)  can I change elections while on leave? I'm worried about missing the window.

People Ops Bot: You can make elections while on leave via the benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.com. If you foresee not being available, you can pre-submit changes before your leave. For special cases, email benefits@redwood.com and we can assist.

Comp & Ben: Note: some changes (like switching medical plans or adding dependents) require supporting docs. Upload them before Nov 14 to ensure enrollment is effective Jan 1. If you're out of the country and need help uploading, we can accept emailed scans to benefits@redwood.com with manager confirmation.

Elena (Product): One more: will being on leave affect parental top-up payments if my review results in a bonus?

Comp & Ben: Parental top-up is processed separately from performance bonus. Bonuses that are approved during your leave will still be paid according to the scheduled bonus payout. We recommend notifying payroll@redwood.com if bank/account details change while you're away.

Liam (Manager): I'll take care of the calibration note and ensure approvals are routed correctly. Elena, feel free to ping me if you want me to submit anything on your behalf while you're out.

Elena (Product): Thanks all  will upload self-assessment and benefits changes this week. Appreciate the help :sparkles:

People Ops: Checklist for visibility:
- Submit 1-paragraph self-assessment + 2 bullets by Nov 9
- Manager to add calibration note before Nov 15 (Liam)
- Ensure comp approval packets are complete (comp@redwood.com)
- Benefits enroll via portal or email docs to benefits@redwood.com by Nov 14
- Notify payroll@redwood.com if banking changes while on leave

Elena (Product): Uploading now :white_check_mark:
